_how: Upload each file below ONCE to the CCM Sitefinity library (fonts and ccm-styles.css: Content > Documents & Files; graphics: Content > Images). Open the uploaded item, copy its link (it starts with https://ccm.kfupm.edu.sa/), paste it between the quotes, save, and run the build again. Leave a link empty until the file is uploaded. ccm-styles.css is in CCM/upload/ (made by the build); the other files are in design-system/.
